claim: If a game decompresses its code at load, the decompressor is overwritten after use and is no hook site; place hooks at a boundary that runs after decompression.

evidence.text: Original TZX/BASIC reaches the first USR 24200; the decompressor at 86C5 is overwritten, so it is rejected as a hook site; the pause boundary 8EF9 follows the original DI.
